notes.subject: מגורי
notes.rationale: 'ples bilong wokabaut/stap wantaim ol arapela man' vs 'pilgrimage' (KJV) vs 'sojourning' — em i stap provisional, i no graun bilong en yet

notes.subject: חקיך
notes.rationale: ol kastom bilong yu — חק em i samting ol i setim, i no 'lo' tasol

translation: Ol sing bilong ol kastom bilong yu i kamap bilong mi, long haus bilong ol ples mi wok long stap wantaim ol arapela man.
